findings.summary: The amended RFC retained contradictory normative requirements from the original contract.
The inbound To header fallback allowed a caller-controlled value to reach authentication metadata.
The plan omitted propagation of middleware phone enrichment through infra and core boundaries.
Active SIP deployment selection and ambiguity handling were not deterministic.
Outbound phone-only behavior for aliases and invalid values was unspecified.
Observability requirements lacked bounded values and testable privacy constraints.
Rollback scope omitted propagation, outbound, transfer, and observability changes.

resolution: RFC and plan were rewritten as one coherent contract for round-two challenge.
